caption: For n_in = 100 and n_out = 50, ReLU takes the He branch with variance 0.02 and standard deviation ≈ 0.141; tanh or sigmoid takes the Xavier branch with variance ≈ 0.01333 and standard deviation ≈ 0.115. Both branches then draw weights around zero and set biases to zero.

spec.title: Weight initialization for n_in = 100, n_out = 50
spec.aria: A flow from layer sizes to activation choice, then two branches: ReLU leads to He variance 2 over 100 equals 0.02 and standard deviation about 0.141, while tanh or sigmoid leads to Xavier variance 2 over 150 equals 0.01333 and standard deviation about 0.115; both branches merge to draw weights around zero and set biases to zero.
